name: Keenable
description: Search the public web and read source pages with Keenable.

methods.label: Use public Keenable search
methods.whenToUse: Use Keenable’s public, keyless search MCP.
methods.guidanceMd: The public route exposes search_web_pages and fetch_page_content, both read-only. Keep source URLs with results. Keyless use is rate-limited per IP; this method does not configure an API key.
